title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and reporting pipeline (v20)
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: consolidate profiling baselines and representative workload runners into the benchmark-lab and add a reporting pipeline so we can track regressions across hardware/quantization variants. This PR bundles three coordinated pieces: (1) profiling baselines (yaml + harness) to capture end-to-end latency/cost baselines for representative models and prompt mixes; (2) a set of representative workload runners that exercise typical request patterns (chat, completion, streaming, embedding) with realistic sequence length distributions and KV-cache warmup flows; (3) a reporting pipeline (Dagster + BigQuery/metrics exporter) to materialize daily regression reports and make baselines queryable from the console. What changed (summary): added perf-canary/profiling/baselines/{resnet,gpt-like}-baseline-*.yaml; added benchmark-lab/runners/representative/{chat_runner.py,completion_runner.py,embedding_runner.py,streaming_runner.py} and workload definitions; added benchmark-lab/reporting/pipeline/dagster_pipeline.py and SQL materialized views + example dashboards; added .github/workflows/benchmark-ci.yml to run representative runners in CI on a restricted GPU pool; instrumented runs with tags/trace IDs for traceability; added docs/benchmark-lab/README.md with runbook and upgrade notes. Testing and validation: local runs on a 4-GPU dev pool validated latency/throughput profiles; end-to-end nightly job verified reports in a staging BigQuery dataset; CI implements a smoke test to ensure runners start, emit metrics, and complete a tiny synthetic workload. See CI checks for details. Rollout plan: merge to main -> staged rollout to benchmark infra -> enable full daily runs in staging -> compare baselines -> promote to production pipeline. Backstop: pipeline job is guarded behind a feature flag and uses dedicated staging dataset until we confirm stability. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baseline specs and harness - [x] Add representative runners and workload definitions - [x] Add reporting DAG and query templates - [x] Update CI to include smoke runs - [x] Add docs and runbook Notes: kept baseline specs compact and documented default sampling windows. The initial baselines target x1 and x4 GPU variants and CPU-only emulator for unit tests. Follow-up PRs will add more model variants and continuous regression alerts.
